name.en-US: Ethel's Book, or Tales of the Angels
name.pt-BR: O Livro de Ethel, ou Histórias dos Anjos

description.en-US: Ethel's Book, or Tales of the Angels (1858): four stories for children by Faber, written for Lady Etheldreda Howard: The Last Children, or the Beautiful Midnight; Philip's Death, or the Pains of Children; The Melancholy Heart, or the Child to Whom Nobody Was Kind; and The Weeping Angel.
description.pt-BR: O Livro de Ethel, ou Histórias dos Anjos (1858): quatro contos para crianças escritos por Faber para Lady Etheldreda Howard: Os Últimos Meninos, ou a Bela Meia-Noite; A Morte de Filipe, ou as Dores das Crianças; O Coração Melancólico, ou a Criança com Quem Ninguém Foi Bondoso; e O Anjo que Chora.

en-US.editor: Frederick William Faber (London: Thomas Richardson and Son, 1858)

sources.edition: Ethel's Book, or Tales of the Angels (London: Thomas Richardson and Son, 1858), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The dedication and the four tales; the contents is dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1858, so the text is public domain.
